Privacy.metaDescription: What marek.media stores and processes, why, for how long, and what rights you have.
Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.lead: What marek.media stores about you, why and for how long. In short: no analytics and no advertising, only what the site and its mini game need to run.
Privacy.whoText: The controller of personal data is Marek Marek. Identification and contact details are on the <contact>Contact</contact> page.
Privacy.noToolsHeading: What the site does not use.
Privacy.noToolsText: No analytics, advertising or tracking tools, and no scripts from advertising networks.
Privacy.deviceHeading: What is stored on your device.
Privacy.deviceIntro: It only makes the site work and keeps your settings. We do not use it to track you:
Privacy.deviceStorage: your chosen theme (light or dark), your longest run in the mini game and your last nickname. They are kept in the browser storage (localStorage), stay on your device only, and you can delete them in your browser settings,
Privacy.deviceCookie: the NEXT_LOCALE cookie remembers the language you chose and lasts only for the browser session.
Privacy.gameText: After every game that you end or leave (with a new game, the space bar, the Esc key, by going to another page or by closing the page) and that lasted at least 5 seconds, the result is saved on the server: the nickname (1 to 3 letters or digits), the score, the length of the run and the time of saving. The nickname is pre-filled (DOE, or the one you used last) and you can change it before it is sent. The ten best results are shown publicly in the leaderboard. We do not link the nickname to anything else, so choose one that does not identify you. Results older than 30 days that are not among roughly the thousand best are deleted regularly. The best results and the results I have hidden from the leaderboard (for example because of an inappropriate nickname) are kept until I delete them. I will delete a result on request. The legal basis is the legitimate interest in running the game and keeping it secure (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Privacy.ipText: To protect the game and the interface from being flooded, we count requests from one IP address. The counter stays in an in-memory service for at most 10 minutes and is not stored with the result. The legal basis is the legitimate interest in keeping the site secure.
Privacy.hostingText: The site, the interface and the files run at the providers Vercel, Railway and Cloudflare, the data at the providers of the database (Neon) and the in-memory service (Aiven); they receive data as processors. When a page is delivered they may process technical data (IP address, browser type, time of the request) so the site works and stays secure, and keep it according to their own retention periods. The interface also writes a technical log of every request, including the IP address, the address requested, the browser type and the time. The log is kept at the provider Railway for the period set in its documentation (7 to 30 days depending on the plan). The legal basis is the legitimate interest in running and securing the site. Some providers are based outside the European Union, mainly in the USA. The transfer relies on a European Commission adequacy decision or on standard contractual clauses, depending on how the provider provides for it. I will tell you about the safeguards on request.
Privacy.monitoringText: When an error occurs in the interface (the API), on the server of the site or in the administration, a technical report of it is sent to the service Sentry (sentry.io), which processes it as a processor; our organization is in a data centre in the European Union. The report contains the error message, the stack trace, the address of the request (without the secret parts of links and without parameters), the time and the version of the application. I do not collect the IP address, cookies, headers or the content of requests, and Sentry does not store the IP address; from the sender's address it derives only an approximate location (country and city). The error message may occasionally contain a piece of the content that was being worked with. The legal basis is the legitimate interest in finding and fixing errors. Your browser loads no Sentry code and sends nothing to it when you visit the public site.
Privacy.aiText: When the site administrator uses the AI assistant, content from the administration, including nicknames and scores from the leaderboard, may be sent to the AI providers (Anthropic, Google). The content stays in the assistant's conversation history without automatic deletion. The legal basis is the legitimate interest in managing the site.
Privacy.contactHeading: When you write or call me.
Privacy.contactText: I use your e-mail or phone only to answer and to communicate about your enquiry. There is no contact form on the site. The legal basis is the legitimate interest in answering your enquiry, or negotiating a contract at your request (Art. 6(1)(f) and (b) GDPR). I keep the data for as long as the enquiry needs and as long as the law requires.
Privacy.automatedText: Saving the result is part of the game. If you do not want your result saved, clear the nickname before you leave, or do not play. You have no other obligation to provide data, no law or contract creates one. We do not make automated decisions or profile visitors.
Privacy.rightsText: You can ask for access to your data, its correction or erasure, restriction of processing, object to processing based on legitimate interest and, where it applies to the processing, ask for portability. No processing on this site relies on your consent, so there is nothing to withdraw. Write to me via the <contact>Contact</contact> page. You can lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (<uoou>uoou.gov.cz</uoou>).
Privacy.changesText: I may update this policy, the current version is always on this page. Last updated 10 November 2026.
